agents.heading: Agents
agents.lead: What is running for you, and what can be.

signIn.title: The agents section belongs to your Davoq account
signIn.lead: Sign in with your Davoq panel credentials: that is where what you pay for is recorded.
signIn.unavailable: Could not reach the engine. Try again.
signIn.sidebarHint: Sign in to your Davoq account to see every agent.

short.chatbot: Answers around the clock from your own material and qualifies the lead.
short.voice-assistant: Takes the call nobody answered and books the visit.
short.configurator: Turns the conversation into a costed request and a quote.
short.follow-up: Returns to customers who went quiet, and stops when they reply.
short.order-status: Shows the customer where their order is, without a phone call.
short.content-engine: Prepares posts from your own work.
short.data-analyst: Reads the CRM and says where money is leaking.

agents.subscriptionLead: What is running for you, and what can be.

page.unavailable: This agent is still being built. When it is ready it shows up here, with nothing to ask for.
page.locked: This agent is not running. It is turned on from the subscription, together with the plan that includes it.
page.notPurchasable: This agent comes with a plan that cannot yet be bought from the portal. Write to us and we will turn it on.

unlockPanel.lead: This agent is turned on with the {plan} plan.
unlockPanel.yearlySaving: Two months free compared with paying monthly.
unlockPanel.requested: Request sent. We will call you and turn the agent on.
unlockPanel.changed: The plan has changed. The agent starts in a moment.
unlockPanel.signedOut: Your session expired. Sign in again.
unlockPanel.failed: Could not start the payment. Try again.
unlockPanel.note: Payment goes through your Davoq account. You can cancel at any time — the agent keeps running until the end of the paid period.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.elsewhereLead: Branding, domains and each agent's copy are managed in the Davoq panel, where the agent runs.

knowledgeScreen.dropHint: Drop a .docx, .odt, .pdf, .md or .html file here — or pick one
knowledgeScreen.empty: Nothing yet. Add the first page from the site and the bot can answer from it within seconds.

appearanceScreen.contrastNote: Text colour on the button and in the bubbles is chosen automatically, so the widget never becomes unreadable — but the warnings are worth fixing.
appearanceScreen.disclosureNote: Telling the visitor they are talking to an AI is required by law (AI Act, art. 50) and cannot be switched off. You can change the wording; an empty field restores the default.

installScreen.verifyLead: We open the page and look for the code carrying your key.
installScreen.scriptMissing: The widget code is not on the page
installScreen.keyMissing: Your key is not on the page
installScreen.domainsLead: The widget only answers on these domains — one per line, subdomains included automatically. An empty list means the widget works nowhere.
